fields.name: source port
fields.description: the port of the sending process, if not used, a value of zero is inserted.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: the port of the receiving process.

fields.name: length
fields.description: the number of octets in the udp header and data.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of a pseudo header of information from the ip header, the udp header, and the data.
